method: Every claim (numeric, methodological, structural, comparative, external) re-verified against the corrected provenance store, source code (defense/anim/build, simulation, collector_artifacts, tex body chapters), and the ratified ADJUDICATION.md. Methodological/simulation-vs-measurement axis given priority.

summary.note_1_finding: intro.tex:444 'dominant operator within 3%' mislabels the attention operator as dominant -- the same DEFINITIONAL error ADJUDICATION [E1] fixed in conclusion.tex:39 but did NOT mirror into intro. GEMM (63.2% of kernel time) is dominant; the operator that agrees within 3% is attention (13.6%). intro.tex:248 states it correctly ('encoder-attention operator agrees within 3%').

methodological_axis_findings.language_pool_simulated_not_hardware: CONFIRMED correct framing. Line 316-318 'The language pool is simulated by Dynamo's discrete-event engine (dynamo.replay with a KV-aware router) under AIC-calibrated H100 timing'. Verified: simulation/build_dynamo_src.sh runs `python -m dynamo.replay`; sweep_fig.py:134 labels 'Language pool (dynamo.replay, 2 workers)'. 'AIC-calibrated H100 timing' correctly avoids claiming real H100 hardware.
methodological_axis_findings.encoder_pool_real_silicon: CONFIRMED. Line 305-306 / 444 'collected ... on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090' / 'physical measurement of the same network on the same silicon' -- real phaseE RTX-5090 collection. collector_scalar/collector_encoder_fn confirm real measured data.
methodological_axis_findings.live_validation_mocked_engines: CONFIRMED correct framing -- this is the sibling of the previously-caught closedloop 'real H100 silicon' error, and intro gets it RIGHT. Line 542-544 'replayed against the live Dynamo runtime (real control plane, mocked engines)'. validation.tex:156-157 confirms 'mocked engine execution. It validates the control loop, not GPU silicon.' No overclaim.
methodological_axis_findings.measured_behavior_line43: CONFIRMED (not an overclaim). Line 43 'reproduces the decoupling as measured behavior' -- 'measured' = observed emergent behavior of the explicitly-named 'calibrated discrete-event simulation' in the same sentence, not a hardware-measurement claim.

findings.quote: the kernel-time ledger closed against a physical measurement of the same network on the same silicon (dominant operator within ${\approx}3\%$)
findings.checked_against: provenance.collector_kernel_ledger (n_images=1, entry_kind='category'): gemm 6.029 ms (63.2%), attention 1.300 ms (13.6%), total 9.542 ms; aiconfigurator.tex:450,525 ('agreement within 3% on the collected attention operator', predicted 1.342 vs measured 1.300); ADJUDICATION [E1]/R34 (conclusion.tex:39 'dominant operator' fixed for the same reason).
findings.evidence: The operator that agrees with physical measurement within 3% is the ATTENTION operator (1.300 ms measured / 1.342 ms predicted = 13.6% of kernel time). The DOMINANT operator is GEMM (6.029 ms = 63.2%), which is NOT within 3% (the full GEMM-dominated forward carries the ~0.7 ms remainder over ~10 ms). Calling the within-3% operator 'dominant' is the exact DEFINITIONAL mislabel ADJUDICATION [E1] corrected in conclusion.tex:39 ('validated to ~3% on its dominant operator') -- it was applied there but NOT mirrored to intro.tex:444. intro.tex:248 already states it correctly.
findings.proposed_fix: Replace '(dominant operator within ${\approx}3\%$)' with '(collected attention operator within ${\approx}3\%$)' -- aligning :444 to :248 and to aiconfigurator.tex:525.

findings.evidence: 17% sits inside the surviving 11-19% proxy band; ADJUDICATION explicitly upheld NO EDIT. Approximate but not wrong.
